title: 5 CD Lot: Diane Schuur, Dionne Warwick, Louis Armstrong, Songs for the Wild
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Discs and jewel cases show normal light wear consistent with age/storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Lot of 5 pre-owned jazz and vocal CDs. Includes:

Diane Schuur - Timeless (GRP, 1986), produced by Dave Grusin, featuring special guest soloist Stan Getz
Dionne Warwick - Reservations for Two (Arista, 1987), with duets featuring Jeffrey Osborne, Smokey Robinson, Howard Hewett, Kashif and June Pointer
Louis Armstrong - Jeepers Creepers (Newsound), 18-track collection
Stevan Pasero with Christopher Bock - Songs for the Wild, original compositions dedicated to the preservation of endangered species
The Petersons - A Child Is Born (Pop Sense Records, 1997), Christmas album

All 5 CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.
